subject: mathematics
title: Grade 9 Mathematics
description: Polynomials, coordinate geometry, triangles, and statistics

questions.question: Factorize: x² - 9
questions.explanation: x² - 9 = x² - 3² = (x-3)(x+3). This is the difference of squares identity: a²-b² = (a-b)(a+b).

questions.question: What is the slope of the line y = 3x + 7?
questions.explanation: In y = mx + c form, m is the slope. Here y = 3x + 7, so slope m = 3.

questions.question: In a right triangle, if the two legs are 3 cm and 4 cm, what is the hypotenuse?
questions.explanation: By Pythagoras theorem: c² = a² + b² = 9 + 16 = 25, so c = 5 cm. (3-4-5 Pythagorean triple)

questions.question: What is the distance between points (1, 2) and (4, 6)?
Expand: (a + b)²
questions.explanation: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b². This is the square of a binomial identity.

questions.question: What is the surface area of a cube with side 3 cm?
questions.explanation: Surface area of cube = 6 × side² = 6 × 3² = 6 × 9 = 54 cm².

questions.question: If a set A = {1, 2, 3} and B = {2, 3, 4}, what is A ∩ B?
questions.explanation: A ∩ B is the intersection — elements common to both sets. Both A and B contain 2 and 3, so A ∩ B = {2, 3}.

questions.question: What is the value of sin 30°?
questions.explanation: sin 30° = 1/2. This is one of the standard trigonometric values to memorize.

questions.question: A polynomial 2x³ + 3x² - x + 5 has degree:
questions.explanation: The degree of a polynomial is the highest power of the variable. Here the highest power is 3 (in 2x³).

questions.question: In the equation 2x + 3y = 12, if x = 0, what is y?
The probability that a randomly drawn card from a standard 52-card deck is a heart is:
questions.explanation: There are 13 hearts in a 52-card deck. P(heart) = 13/52 = 1/4.

questions.question: What is the value of (-2)⁴?
questions.explanation: (-2)⁴ = (-2) × (-2) × (-2) × (-2) = 4 × 4 = 16. An even power of a negative number is positive.

questions.question: Euclid's division lemma states: for positive integers a and b, there exist unique integers q and r such that:
questions.explanation: Euclid's division lemma: a = bq + r, where 0 ≤ r < b. q is the quotient and r is the remainder.

questions.question: Two lines are parallel if and only if their slopes are:
questions.explanation: Parallel lines have the same slope (gradient). If m₁ = m₂, the lines are parallel (provided they are not the same line).
